name: Credit Risk
description: Risk of financial loss due to borrower default or credit quality deterioration. This risk category is defined with a stated appetite threshold of less than 0.5% loss ratio per the risk appetite statement.

name: Operational Risk
description: Risk of loss resulting from inadequate or failed internal processes, people, or systems. Includes process failures, human error, and internal fraud. Appetite threshold is less than £50k per year.

name: Compliance Risk
description: Risk of regulatory sanction, financial loss, or reputational damage due to failure to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or internal policies. Zero violations tolerance stated.

name: Technology Risk
description: Risk of loss or service disruption due to technology system failures, cyber attacks, or inadequate IT infrastructure. Appetite threshold is 99.9% uptime.

name: Fraud Risk
description: Risk of financial loss due to fraudulent activities including theft, money laundering, and customer impersonation. Appetite threshold is less than £100k per year.

name: Reputational Risk
description: Risk of damage to the bank's brand, customer confidence, or market position due to negative events, media coverage, or service failures.

name: Liquidity Risk
description: Risk that the bank cannot meet its financial obligations due to insufficient liquid assets or cash flow constraints.

name: Market Risk
description: Risk of financial loss due to adverse movements in market variables including interest rates and currency exchange rates.

name: Credit Risk Loss Ratio
description: Quantitative threshold for acceptable credit losses as a percentage of total credit exposure. Represents the bank's appetite for credit risk.

name: Operational Risk Annual Loss Threshold
description: Maximum acceptable annual operational loss threshold set at less than £50,000 per year, defining the bank's operational risk appetite.

name: Fraud Risk Annual Loss Threshold
description: Maximum acceptable annual fraud loss threshold set at less than £100,000 per year, defining the bank's fraud risk appetite.

name: Technology System Uptime
description: Target system availability metric set at 99.9% uptime, representing the bank's technology risk appetite and service level commitment.

name: Compliance Violation Tolerance
description: Zero-tolerance threshold for regulatory or policy violations, indicating the bank's strict compliance risk appetite.

name: Fraud Risk
description: Fraud risk characterized by likelihood of occurrence ranging from remote to very high depending on control effectiveness and operational context. The document provides a likelihood scale framework for assessing fraud events, with examples ranging from single annual cases to daily processing issues.

name: Operational Risk
description: Operational risk including system downtime and transaction processing failures. The document illustrates this risk with examples of regular system downtime occurring quarterly and daily transaction processing issues as indicators of high to very high likelihood.

name: Data Entry Error Risk
description: Risk of data entry errors occurring at medium likelihood with a frequency of 2–5 errors per month, representing 1 event per 1–3 years. This is classified as a medium likelihood risk in the scoring framework.
context: Example: 2–5 data entry errors per month

name: Security Breach Risk
description: Security breach risk characterized as remote likelihood under ideal conditions with a frequency of less than 1 event per 10 years. The document uses a perfect security system never being breached as the theoretical example of this remote risk level.
context: Example: Perfect security system never breached

name: Fraud Likelihood Score
description: Quantitative metric for assessing fraud likelihood on a 1–5 scale, with Low likelihood defined as 1 event per 3–10 years. This metric is used to score and categorize fraud risk events within the organization's risk assessment framework.

name: Operational Failure Likelihood Score
description: Quantitative metric for assessing operational failure likelihood on a 1–5 scale, with High likelihood defined as 4+ events per year and Very High as weekly or more. Used to evaluate system downtime and transaction processing failures.

name: Financial Loss Impact
description: A quantified risk dimension measuring potential financial loss across five impact levels, ranging from negligible losses under £10k to critical losses exceeding £1M. Used as a component of the bank's impact assessment framework for risk events and incidents.

name: Customer Impact
description: A quantified risk dimension measuring the number of customers affected by a risk event or incident, scaled from 1–5 customers at negligible impact to 500+ customers at critical impact. Reflects the breadth of customer exposure in the bank's impact assessment framework.

name: Regulatory Impact
description: A qualitative risk dimension measuring the severity of regulatory consequences arising from a risk event, ranging from no impact at negligible levels to license suspension or criminal action at critical levels. Reflects the bank's exposure to supervisory enforcement and reputational harm.

name: Negligible Impact Level
description: The lowest impact severity level in the bank's five-point impact scale, defined by financial losses under £10k, 1–5 affected customers, and no regulatory impact.

name: Minor Impact Level
description: The second impact severity level in the bank's five-point impact scale, defined by financial losses of £10k–£100k, 5–25 affected customers, and no formal regulatory action.

name: Moderate Impact Level
description: The middle impact severity level in the bank's five-point impact scale, defined by financial losses of £100k–£500k, 25–100 affected customers, and regulatory review or minor guidance.

name: Major Impact Level
description: The fourth impact severity level in the bank's five-point impact scale, defined by financial losses of £500k–£1M, 100–500 affected customers, and regulatory action including fines or restrictions.

name: Critical Impact Level
description: The highest impact severity level in the bank's five-point impact scale, defined by financial losses exceeding £1M, 500+ affected customers, and severe regulatory consequences including license suspension or criminal action.
